newsitem.title: USA: Cullen/Frost confident of earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Cullen/Frost confident of earnings growth.

text.p: Cullen/Frost Bankers Inc should meet higher earnings projected by brokers for the next quarter and this fiscal year, senior chairman and chief executive officer Tom Frost said on Wednesday.
"The momentum is there, and we think it will keep on going," Frost told Reuters following the San Antonio-based bank holding company's annual shareholders meeting.

Analysts projected earnings of $0.66 per share for the second quarter ending in June versus $0.59 in the second quarter of fiscal 1996, and earnings of $2.69 per share for 1997, up from $2.40 a share in fiscal 1996, according to First Call.
"Those are reasonable estimates they have made," Frost said of the analysts' consensus estimates. "We think the market is understanding and really appreciating what is happening."
